♊ The Gemini Cloth. [OFFENSE]

Cloth Passive — Two Faces

You are trained in Deception. You have two aspects, Light and Shadow, and swap between them as a free action once per hour.

In Shadow, @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Another Dimension] instead becomes a single-target confuse effect (Will save, confused 1 round on a failure).

Your appearance, voice, and aura change completely. You have two identities that nothing short of true seeing connects.

Techniques

  • 1st — Signature (L1) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Another Dimension]
  • 2nd (L6) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Astral Projection]
  • 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Galaxian Explosion]
  • 4th — Ultimate (L16) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Mavros Eruption Clast]

Ascendant Boon — Galaxian Cosmo [OFFENSE]

Cast your 1st Technique without spending a Focus Point once per round, and @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Galaxian Explosion]'s burst increases by 20 feet.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Gemini)]

Zenith Boon — Galaxian Cosmo (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, plus a duplicate of you appears each turn in an adjacent square: your statistics, acting on your initiative with 2 actions, Strike and Stride only — no Techniques, no Focus Points, no skill actions. One at a time; it vanishes at the start of your next turn.

Running the duplicate: copy the token and delete it at the top of the next turn. It is deliberately not a second full character.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Gemini)]
